categories.name: Would You Rather
categories.description: Two concrete options. Pick one each.

rules.summary: Both pick at the same time, then explain.
rules.purpose: Learn how the other thinks through quick, concrete choices.
rules.round_end: The round ends once you've both explained.
steps: Read both options out loud.
Count to three and say A or B at the same time.
The person who read the card explains their pick first.

categories.name: Mini Challenges
categories.description: Small, timed challenges you can do on a call.

rules.summary: A quick challenge with a timer.
rules.purpose: Get off the sofa for a minute and make each other laugh.
rules.turns: Do the challenge together unless the card says otherwise.
rules.scoring: The card says if there's a winner. Otherwise you both win.
rules.video_call: Designed for video calls. Everything uses what's within reach.
steps: Read the challenge out loud.
Tap Start timer when you're both ready.
Stop when the timer ends and compare.

cards.text: You each have 30 seconds to find an old photo that makes you laugh. Show them at the same time.
Draw each other's portrait without looking at the paper. Reveal them together.
Take turns naming films with a one-word title. The first to hesitate for five seconds loses.
Find something in your room that sums up your week. Explain it in one sentence.
Without checking, guess the exact time to the minute. The closest guess wins.
Write a four-line poem about today. Read them out together.
Take turns naming foods that start with M. The first to repeat one or freeze loses.
Do a kind, recognisable impression of someone you both know. The other guesses who.
Show the most recent screenshot on your phone and explain why you took it.
Invent a dish using only three ingredients from your kitchen. Pitch it like a restaurant menu.
Balance a spoon on your nose. The longest balance wins.
Hum a song. The other has to guess it before time runs out.
Find the oldest thing you own within reach and tell its story.
Take turns giving each other compliments. No repeats, no pauses longer than three seconds.
Pick a random object nearby and sell it to the other like an advert.
Spell both your full names backwards out loud. The fastest correct attempt wins.
Describe tomorrow's ideal lunch in exactly ten words.
Make the other laugh without saying a word.
Tell a story one sentence each, starting with: "The suitcase was much heavier than expected."
Name ten animals between you, taking turns. Beat the timer together.
Recreate a childhood photo of yourself as closely as you can with what's nearby.
Draw your dream house in one minute. Compare whose kitchen is bigger.
Find something blue, something soft and something older than you. The first to show all three wins.
Describe a famous place without naming it. The other guesses.
Talk for 45 seconds about a topic the other chooses, without saying "um".
Give a tour of the room you're in as if you were a hotel guide.
Rename five everyday objects nearby. The other has to guess what each one is.
Find three things within reach that start with the same letter. The fastest wins.
Tidy the space around you as fast as you can. Show the before and after.
Announce the biggest news of your day like a TV news presenter.
Teach each other one word in a language the other doesn't know. Test each other at the end of the call.
Each of you picks a secret word. Use it naturally before the call ends without the other noticing.
List as many countries as you can that start with the letter S, taking turns.

rules.summary: Write your answer privately, then reveal together.
rules.purpose: Compare how you each remember the moments you actually share.
rules.scoring: A point together for every match. Different memories aren't wrong; talk about them.
steps: Read the card out loud.
Each of you writes your answer privately, on paper or in your notes app.
Reveal at the same time and compare the details.

categories.name: Plan It Together
categories.description: A small brief with real limits. Agree on every point.

rules.summary: Agree on a small plan before the timer runs out.
rules.purpose: Practise making a real plan together, quickly and fairly.
rules.turns: Plan together. Swap who reads each card.
rules.round_end: When every point is agreed or the timer ends.
rules.scoring: No points. A plan finished in time is a keeper.
steps: Read the brief and its limits.
Start the timer.
Agree on every point in the brief before time runs out. Save it to Date Ideas if you want to do it for real.
